tool_calls.name: /bin/zsh -lc 'cat PROJECT_BRIEF.md 2>/dev/null; find . -name AGENTS.md -print; rg -n "package logx|type LogConf|Add.*Field|With.*Field|serviceName" logx'
/bin/zsh -lc "cat core/logx/config.go; cat core/logx/fields.go; sed -n '1,240p' core/logx/logs.go; sed -n '1,220p' core/logx/logger.go; sed -n '1,160p' core/logx/vars.go"

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '220,520p' core/logx/logs.go; rg -n 'func.*write|new.*Logger|LogField|fields' core/logx/richlogger.go core/logx/lesslogger.go core/logx/logwriter.go; sed -n '1,180p' core/logx/readme-cn.md"
/bin/zsh -lc 'gofmt -w core/logx/logs.go core/logx/writer.go && git diff -- core/logx/logs.go core/logx/writer.go core/logx/readme-cn.md && git status --short'
